description: L34 subject_staging: a multi-character panel at medium-or-wider distance with no staging declared must HARD-fail, and an unknown staging value must HARD-fail. Regression pin for the 2026-08-13 fix — the check read panel.cast (always absent; the shotlist schema field is `characters`), so it could never fire. Boundary pins: a staged cowboy panel, an undeclared mcu panel (not load-bearing), and a single-character full panel must all stay clean.

expect_hard.message_contains: at 'medium' distance has no subject_staging declared
